turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm a nurse on night shifts. What's a decent thing to eat before I leave at seven in the evening?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Something balanced that won't make you sleepy. Think protein and slow carbs, like a chicken and bean wrap or an omelette with toast.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And during the shift? I usually end up eating crisps at three in the morning.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Pack a small second meal, like a pot of soup or a grain salad. Light and easy to eat standing up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I never have time to cook, though.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Make one big tray bake on your day off and portion it out. Roast vegetables, chickpeas and some chicken thighs keep well for four days.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: if I'm not too tired on my day off.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Even an hour on Sunday afternoon covers most of the week. Your three in the morning self will thank you.
